_doc: A Bulgar or Slav of about 900 in the base dress every Bulgar unit wears (#477), drawn as bulgar.vox (written by tools/vox/bulgar.lobster) from the approved concept sheet: the Roman body's build and points, short dark hair, a drooping moustache, a white shirt, a long sleeveless coat in team colour with a red braid, the wide red sash, white breeches, black leg wraps crossed with cords, opanci. Caps, helmets, armour, shields and weapons are gear over it. The behaviour is the Roman body's.

check._doc: shows: as the human body, this one is mostly its clothes: white shirt sleeves and breeches, as the sheet has them (#477)
